title: Gap Assessment
description: Capabilities are tested to find gaps; the assessment is systematic. Gaps get found. Blind spots get lit.

demo.code:

print("found: 12 gaps (lit!)")

print("technique:", _jah_schema["technique"])
assert set(_jah_schema) == set(['technique', 'gap', 'method', 'measure', 'benefit', 'complexity']) and all(_jah_schema.values())
print("schema verified:", len(_jah_schema), "fields")
